entry.title: Updated: dsh-session-move
entry.summary: Move a session to another folder from the Web UI via drag & drop or a menu picker, permanently delete a session with a risk-consent dialog, and AI-rename a session by summarizing the whole conversation (typo-aware). Each action also ships as an agent tool. Exact install spec: github:reinocheong/dsh-session-move. Source event: dsh-market/dsh-market; changed: sources.
